MiniGalaxy: Use GOG Galaxy on Windows or download your owned games directly from GOG; no account credentials are included.
Foliate / Cozy: Use Calibre for EPUBs and VLC for audiobook files; the original content sources stay in the catalog.
Kiwix: Download the Windows desktop build from https://kiwix.org/en/applications/ and open the same ZIM files.
Vocalinux / Speech Note: The Linux installations do not copy across; choose a Windows-native dictation workflow separately.
Flatpak, Synaptic, GParted and Linux des: Linux-specific packages are not installed on Windows. Use Windows/vendor tools appropriate to the job.
